{"subject":"Claim C020975 past filing limit - write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C020975 (patient PT0066, service code S5125, date of service 2026-09-04, billed $162.00 for 30 units) was submitted on 2026-11-25, 82 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, so the claim is predicted to be denied under code D03.

Editing the claim cannot fix this. I need a write-off decision from you on this claim. Please let me know your decision as soon as possible, since the claim cannot be corrected to avoid the denial.

Thank you."}
